examples.text: cattāri ṭhānāni naro pamatto, āpajjati paradār'ūpasevī, apuññalābhaṃ na nikāmaseyyaṃ, nindaṃ tatīyaṃ nirayaṃ catutthaṃ.
apuññalābho ca gatī ca pāpikā, bhītassa bhītāya ratī ca thokikā, rājā ca daṇḍaṃ garukaṃ paṇeti, tasmā naro paradāraṃ na seve.

6701.meaning1: not possessing merit; devoid of spiritual wealth; inauspicious
6701.construction:
na > a + √puṇ + ya + vant
apuñña + vant

examples.text: yāvatā, bho, rañño pasenadissa kosalassa vijitaṃ yattha ca rājā pasenadi kosalo issariy'ādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāreti, pahoti tattha rājā pasenadi kosalo samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā puññavantaṃ vā apuññavantaṃ vā brahmacariyavantaṃ vā abrahmacariyavantaṃ vā tamhā ṭhānā cāvetuṃ vā pabbājetuṃ vā'ti.

6702.meaning1: demeritorious intention; negative karmic formations; unwholesome intentional activities
6702.commentary: (DNa) apuññ'ābhisaṅkhāro. dvādasaakusalacittasampayuttānaṃ cetanānaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. vuttam'pi c'etaṃ tattha katamo apuññ'ābhisaṅkhāro? akusalacetanā kām'āvacarā, ayaṃ vuccati apuññ'ābhisaṅkhāro'ti.

examples.text: yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno avijjā pahīnā hoti vijjā uppannā, so avijjāvirāgā vijj'uppādā n'eva puññ'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti na apuññ'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti na āneñj'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti.

6703.meaning1: headed according to one's demerit; (or) headed towards a demeritorious destination
6703.commentary: (SNa) puññ'ūpagaṃ hoti viññāṇan'ti kammaviññāṇaṃ kammapuññena upagataṃ sampayuttaṃ hoti, vipākaviññāṇaṃ vipākapuññena.

examples.text: apuññaṃ ce saṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, apuññ'ūpagaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ. āneñjaṃ ce saṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti āneñj'ūpagaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ.

idha, bhikkhave, asappuriso yo hoti parassa avaṇṇo taṃ apuṭṭho'pi pātu karoti, ko pana vādo puṭṭhassa! puṭṭho kho pana pañh'ābhinīto ahāpetvā alambitvā paripūraṃ vitthārena parassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsitā hoti. veditabbam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso ayaṃ bhavan'ti.

6705.meaning1: without a son; childless; without heirs
6705.meaning2: without a son; childless; without heirs
6705.construction:
na > a + putta + ka
aputta + ka

examples.text: duggat'āhaṃ pure āsiṃ, vidhavā ca aputtikā, vinā mittehi ñātīhi, bhattacoḷassa n'ādhigaṃ.

6706.meaning1: outside the realm of ordinary folk; not the domain of common people; not experienced by the general public
6706.commentary: (DHPa) aputhujjanasevitan'ti puthujjanehi asevitaṃ ariyasevitam'eva. (THIa) buddh'ādīhi ariyehi eva gocarabhāvan'ābhigamato sevitattā aputhujjanasevitaṃ

examples.text: phusāmi nekkhammasukhaṃ, aputhujjanasevitaṃ, bhikkhu vissāsam'āpādi, appatto āsavakkhayaṃ.
akampiyaṃ atuliyaṃ, aputhujjanasevitaṃ, buddho dhammam'adesesi, tattha me nirato mano, tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.

6707.meaning1: not being again; no renewed existence

examples.text: disvāna rūpesu vihaññamāne, ruppanti rūpesu janā pamattā, tasmā tuvaṃ piṅgiya appamatto, jahassu rūpaṃ apunabbhavāya.

6708.meaning1: non-returning; not coming back; not being reborn; (comm) Nibbāna
6708.commentary: (SNa) apun'āgamanaṃ anāgantā puriso maccudheyyā'ti tebhūmakavaṭṭasaṅkhātā maccudheyyā apun'āgamanasaṅkhātaṃ nibbānaṃ anāgantā. nibbānañ'hi sattā na pun'āgacchanti, tasmā taṃ apun'āgamanan'ti vuccati. taṃ kāmesu baddho ca pamatto ca anāgantā nāma hoti, so taṃ pāpuṇituṃ na sakkoti, tasmā evam'āha.

examples.text: na santi kāmā manujesu niccā, sant'īdha kamanīyāni yesu baddho, yesu pamatto apun'āgamanaṃ, anāgantā puriso maccudheyyā'ti.

6709.meaning2: what is called not coming back to; i.e. Nibbāna

6710.construction:
na > a + pubba + aṃ
apubba + aṃ

examples.text: saññā nu kho, bhante, paṭhamaṃ uppajjati, pacchā ñāṇaṃ, udāhu ñāṇaṃ paṭhamaṃ uppajjati, pacchā saññā, udāhu saññā ca ñāṇañ'ca apubbaṃ acarimaṃ uppajjantī'ti?
ath'assa majjhimayāme atikkante apubbaṃ acarimaṃ akkhīni c'eva kilesā ca bhijjiṃsu. so sukkhavipassako arahā hutvā gabbhaṃ pavisitvā nisīdi.

ath'assa majjhimayāme atikkante apubbaṃ acarimaṃ akkhīni c'eva kilesā ca bhijjiṃsu. so sukkhavipassako arahā hutvā gabbhaṃ pavisitvā nisīdi.

6712.grammar: pp of na purakkharoti, comp, neg
6712.construction:
na > a + pura + khata
na + purakkhata

examples.text: yena naṃ vajjuṃ puthujjanā, atho samaṇabrāhmaṇā, taṃ tassa apurakkhataṃ, tasmā vādesu n'ejati.

6713.grammar: prp of na purakkharoti, comp vb, neg, intrans
6713.commentary: (SNa) apurakkharāno'ti vaṭṭaṃ purato akurumāno. (NIDD1a) apurakkharāno'ti āyatiṃ attabhāvaṃ anabhinibbattento.

examples.text: okaṃ pahāya aniketasārī, gāme akubbaṃ muni santhavāni, kāmehi ritto apurakkharāno, kathaṃ na viggayha janena kayirā'ti.
kathañ'ca, gahapati, apurakkharāno hoti? idha, gahapati, ekaccassa na evaṃ hoti, evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatam'addhānaṃ

6714.grammar: prp of na purekkharoti, comp vb, neg, intrans

6715.meaning1: not revered; not venerated; not honoured

examples.text: aññatitthiyā pana paribbājakā asakkatā honti agarukatā amānitā apūjitā anapacitā, na lābhino cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānapaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhārānaṃ.
pañca uppalahatthāni, āveḷatthaṃ ahaṃsu me, tena buddhaṃ apūjesiṃ, pasanno sehi pāṇibhi.

seyyathā'pi, rājañña, kassako bījanaṅgalaṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya. so tattha sukhette subhūme suvihatakhāṇukaṇṭake bījāni patiṭṭhapeyya akhaṇḍāni apūtīni avāt'ātapahatāni sāradāni sukhasayitāni. devo ca kālena kālaṃ sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.

6718.meaning2: fact of being an egg that is not rotten

6719.meaning1: not rotten; not spoiled; not decayed
6719.construction:
na > a + √pūy + ti + ka
apūti + ka
6719.commentary: (SNa) apūtikānī'ti udakatemanena apūtikāni. pūtibījañ'hi bīj'atthāya na upakappati.

examples.text: imāni c'assu, bhikkhave, pañca bījajātāni akhaṇḍāni apūtikāni avāt'ātapahatāni sār'ādāni sukhasayitāni, pathavī ca n'āssa, āpo ca n'āssa, api nu'māni, bhikkhave, pañca bījajātāni vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyun'ti?
tassa apūti-kāyakamm'antassa apūti-vacīkamm'antassa apūti-manokamm'antassa bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti, bhaddikā kālaṅ'kiriyā.

6723.grammar: prp of na pūreti, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
6723.meaning2: not filling up; not making full; not fulfilling

6724.grammar: adj, in comps, from apekkhati (+acc or +loc)
6724.synonym: aṭṭhika, aṭṭhiya, atthika, atthiya, anugiddha, iccha, icchaka, kāmaka, kāmī, giddhī, gedhitacitta, jigīsaka, patthanaka

examples.text: na taṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanam'āhu dhīrā, yadāyasaṃ dārujaṃ pabbajañ'ca, sārattarattā maṇikuṇḍalesu, puttesu dāresu ca yā apekkhā.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ bhuttāviṃ pavāritaṃ anatirittena khādanīyena vā bhojanīyena vā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, handa bhikkhu khāda vā bhuñja vā'ti jānaṃ āsādana-apekkho, bhuttasmiṃ pācittiyaṃ.

6726.meaning2: waiting for, looking for, candidate, expectant

examples.text: icchānidānā bhavasātabaddhā, te duppamuñcā na hi aññamokkhā, pacchā pure vā'pi apekkhamānā, ime'va kāme purime'va jappaṃ.
ye pana te kulaputtā… indriyesu guttadvārā bhojane mattaññuno jāgariyaṃ anuyuttā sāmaññe apekkhavanto sikkhāya tibbagāravā… tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
otiṇṇo nāma sāratto apekkhavā paṭibaddhacitto.
mayūrakoñc'ābhirutamhi kānane, dīpīhi byagghehi purakkhato vasaṃ, kāye apekkhaṃ jaha mā virādhaya, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
na taṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanam'āhu dhīrā, yadāyasaṃ dārujapabbajañ'ca, sārattarattā maṇikuṇḍalesu, puttesu dāresu ca yā apekkhā.

dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa, kiñ'c'āpi yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ ucc'āvacāni kiṃkaraṇīyāni tattha ussukkaṃ āpanno hoti, atha khv'āssa tibba-apekkhā hoti adhisīlasikkhāya adhicittasikkhāya adhipaññāsikkhāya.

6737.meaning2: waiting for, looking for, candidate, expectant

examples.text: na kho mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ vihesā-apekhā pucchimha, api c'āyasmā khemako pahosi tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ vitthārena ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ.

6740.meaning2: looks for, longs for, pays regard to (accusative or locative); has reference to

examples.text: anikkasāvo kāsāvaṃ, yo vatthaṃ paridahissati, apeto damasaccena, na so kāsāvam'arahati.
aciraṃ vat'ayaṃ kāyo, pathaviṃ adhisessati, chuddho apetaviññāṇo, niratthaṃ'va kaliṅgaraṃ.
ghaṭikāro kho, mahārāja, kumbhakāro nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇo apetajātarūparajato.
āgantukassa bhattaṃ āgantukabhattaṃ, methunā apeto methun'āpeto, corā bhayaṃ corabhayaṃ, rañño putto rājaputto, dhaññānaṃ rāsi dhaññarāsi, rūpe saññā rūpasaññā, saṃsāre dukkhaṃ saṃsāradukkhaṃ.

apa + e + ta + tta
apeta + tta

6748.commentary: (THa) bhayahetūnaṃ kilesānaṃ apagatattā apetalomahaṃso, etena sammāpaṭipattiyā phalaṃ dasseti. (JAa) apetalomahaṃsassā'ti attānuvād'ādibhayehi nibbhayassa.

6749.meaning1: free from anguish; rid of sadness
6749.commentary: (VVa) apetasokā'ti sokahetūnaṃ bhogabyasan'ādīnaṃ abhāvena apagatasokā. tena cittadukkh'ābhāvam'āha. (PYt) apeto soko imassā'ti apetasoko

examples.text: na mandiyā sayāmi n'āpi kāveyyamatto, atthaṃ samecc'āham'apetasoko, eko vivitte sayan'āsanamhi, sayām'ahaṃ sabbabhūt'ānukampī.
sele yathā pabbatamuddhaniṭṭhito, yathā'pi passe janataṃ samantato, tath'ūpamaṃ dhammamayaṃ sumedho, pāsādam'āruyha samantacakkhu, sok'āvatiṇṇaṃ janatam'apetasoko, avekkhati jātijar'ābhibhūtan'ti.

6750.commentary: (THIa) nibbuyhati susānaṃ, aciraṃ kāyo apetaviññāṇo'ti ayaṃ kāyo aciren'eva apagataviññāṇo susānaṃ nibbuyhati upanīyati.

examples.text: aciraṃ vat'ayaṃ kāyo, paṭhaviṃ adhisessati, chuḍḍho apetaviññāṇo, niratthaṃ'va kaliṅgaraṃ.
saññā hi, bho, purisassa attā. sā ca kho upeti'pi apeti'pi. yasmiṃ samaye upeti, saññī tasmiṃ samaye hoti. yasmiṃ samaye apeti, asaññī tasmiṃ samaye hotī'ti. itth'eke abhisaññānirodhaṃ paññapenti.
sā aparena samayena saṃvāsam'anvāya vissāsam'anvāya sassum'pi sasuram'pi sāmikam'pi evam'āha, apetha, kiṃ pana tumhe jānāthā'ti!

6753.meaning1: not honouring one's father; not respecting one's father

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye petteyyā, atha kho et'eva bahutarā sattā ye apetteyyā

6754.grammar: fem, abstr, from na petteyya, neg
6754.construction:
na > a + pitar > pettar + *eyya + tā
apetteyya + tā
6754.commentary: (DNa) amatteyyatā'ti-ādīsu mātu hito matteyyo, tassa bhāvo matteyyatā, mātari sammā paṭipattiyā etaṃ nāmaṃ. tassā abhāvo c'eva tappaṭipakkhatā ca amatteyyatā. apetteyyat'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: aḍḍhateyyavassasat'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu ime dhammā vepullam'agamaṃsu. amatteyyatā apetteyyatā asāmaññatā abrahmaññatā na kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyitā.

6755.meaning1: undrinkable; not fit to be drunk
6755.meaning2: not drinkable, that should not be drunk

examples.text: tassa evam'assa, idaṃ kho parittaṃ gopade udakaṃ. sac'āhaṃ añjalinā vā pivissāmi bhājanena vā khobhessāmi'pi taṃ loḷessāmi'pi taṃ apeyyam'pi taṃ karissāmi.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso loṇakapallaṃ paritte udakamallake pakkhipeyya. taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu taṃ parittaṃ udakaṃ amunā loṇakapallena loṇaṃ assa apeyyan'ti?

6756.grammar: prp of na piyyati, neg, pass, intrans

examples.text: amanussaṭṭhāne udakaṃ'va sītaṃ, tadapeyyamānaṃ parisosam'eti, evaṃ dhanaṃ kāpuriso labhitvā, n'ev'attanā bhuñjati no dadāti.

6757.meaning1: sent out; sent forth; ordered to attack
6757.commentary: (DNa) iti tattha mahāseno, kaṇho senaṃ apesayī'ti evaṃ tattha mahāsamaye mahāseno māro mārasenaṃ apesayi.

examples.text: iti tattha mahāseno, kaṇho senaṃ apesayi, pāṇinā talam'āhacca, saraṃ katvāna bheravaṃ.

anujānāmi, bhikkhave, pañcah'aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ sāmaṇerapesakaṃ sammannituṃ, yo na chand'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na dos'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na moh'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na bhay'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, pesita-apesitañ'ca jāneyya.

6760.commentary: (DNa) apehī'ti apagaccha. thero ekavacanen'eva tālavaṇṭaṃ nikkhipitvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.

examples.text: atha ca pana bhagavā pacchime kāle āyasmantaṃ upavāṇaṃ apasāreti, apehi, bhikkhu, mā me purato aṭṭhāsī'ti.
atha naṃ, idaṃ sītalaṃ bhavissatī'ti kaṭacchuṃ pūretvā ādāya āgacchantiṃ uttarāya dāsiyo disvā, apehi dubbinīte, na tvaṃ amhākaṃ ayyāya pakkuthitaṃ sappiṃ āsiñcituṃ anucchavikā'ti.

6761.grammar: prp of na potheti, neg, trans (+acc)
6761.meaning1: not beating; not hitting; not hurting

examples.text: appam'pi ce sahitaṃ bhāsamāno, dhammassa hoti anudhammacārī, rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca pahāya mohaṃ, sammappajāno suvimuttacitto, anupādiyāno idha vā huraṃ vā, sa bhāgavā sāmaññassa hoti.
paṇītaṃ yadi vā lūkhaṃ, appaṃ vā yadi vā bahuṃ, yāpan'atthaṃ abhuñjiṃsu, agiddhā n'ādhimucchitā.

6763.synonym: appamatta, appamattaka, oramattaka, thokaka, dahara, parittaka, rassa

katamañ'ca, gahapati, ānaṇyasukhaṃ? idha, gahapati, kulaputto na kassaci kiñci dhāreti appaṃ vā bahuṃ vā.
idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa appakaṃ sutaṃ hoti

6766.meaning1: few things; few people; small amount

6775.meaning1: little fatigue; little tiredness; little weariness

examples.text: kacci, bhikkhu, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci'si appakilamathena addhānaṃ āgato, na ca piṇḍakena kilanto'sī'ti? khamanīyaṃ bhagavā, yāpanīyaṃ bhagavā, appakilamathena c'āhaṃ, bhante, addhānaṃ āgato, na piṇḍakena kilanto'mhī'ti.

6776.meaning1: not cheeky; courteous; respectful; modest; unassuming

examples.text: santussako ca subharo ca, appakicco ca sallahukavutti, sant'indriyo ca nipako ca, appagabbho kulesu ananugiddho.
patilīno akuhako, apihālu amaccharī, appagabbho ajeguccho, pesuṇeyye ca no yuto.

6777.meaning1: of little value; not worth much
6777.commentary: (VAt) app'agghan'ti atijiṇṇ'ādi-bhāvena nihīnaṃ. (ANt) appaṃ agghatī'ti app'aggho. atibahuṃ agghanto kahāpaṇagghanako hoti.

examples.text: anāpatti ñātakānaṃ, pavāritānaṃ, aññass'atthāya, attano dhanena, mah'agghaṃ cetāpetu'kāmassa app'agghaṃ cetāpeti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

6778.meaning1: fact of having little value; fact of being not worth much

examples.text: yesaṃ kho pana so paṭiggaṇhāti cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhāraṃ, tesaṃ taṃ na mahapphalaṃ hoti na mah'ānisaṃsaṃ. idam'assa app'agghatāya vadāmi. seyyathā'pi so, bhikkhave, potthako app'aggho tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.

6779.meaning1: not making clear; not making visible; not making evident
6779.commentary: (NIDD1a) kusal'ākusalakammesu viparītavuttiyā sabhāvagahaṇābhāvena vā ekam'pi kammaṃ etassa paccakkhaṃ n'atthi, sayaṃ vā kassaci dhammassa paccakkhakaraṇaṃ nāma na hotī'ti apaccakkhakammaṃ.

examples.text: rūpe kho, vaccha, appaccakkhakammā, rūpasamudaye appaccakkhakammā, rūpanirodhe appaccakkhakammā, rūpanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya appaccakkhakammā ….

6780.grammar: ger of na paccakkhāti, neg, trans (+acc)
6780.meaning1: not giving up; not disavowing; not renouncing; not rejecting
6780.construction:
na > a + pati > paty > pacc + ā + √khā + ya
na + paccakkhāya

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pi, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.

6781.meaning1: causeless; without condition; for no reason
6781.construction: na > a + pati > paty > pacc + √i > ay + *a
6781.commentary: (VIBHa) ahetu appaccayā'ti hetuñ'ca paccayañ'ca vinā akāraṇen'eva paṭisaṃvedetī'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte kathaṃ nu kho, bho, abhisaññānirodho hotī'ti? tatr'ekacce evam'āhaṃsu, ahetū appaccayā purisassa saññā uppajjanti'pi nirujjhanti'pi. yasmiṃ samaye uppajjanti, saññī tasmiṃ samaye hoti.

pūraṇo, bhante, kassapo evam'āha, n'atthi hetu n'atthi paccayo sattānaṃ saṃkilesāya, ahetū appaccayā sattā saṃkilissanti. n'atthi hetu n'atthi paccayo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā, ahetū appaccayā sattā visujjhantī'ti. idha, bhagavā kim'āhā'ti?

6782.construction: na > a + pati > paty > pacc + √i > ay + *a

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo, appam'pi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.

ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, āvuso, vijjati yaṃ taṃ bhikkhuṃ bhikkhū jāneyyuṃ, āpattiṃ āpanno'ti. jānanti maṃ bhikkhū āpattiṃ āpanno'ti, iti so kupito hoti appatīto. yo c'eva kho, āvuso, kopo yo ca appaccayo, ubhayam'etaṃ aṅgaṇaṃ.

6783.meaning1: (vinaya) not renounced ownership; not relinquished possession
6783.construction: na > a + pati > paty > pacc + ud + √dhar + ta

examples.text: appaccuddhaṭe paccuddhaṭasaññī, aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

6784.grammar: nt, act, from na paccuddharati, neg
6784.construction: na > a + pati > paty > pacc + ud + √dhar > dhār + *aṇa
6784.commentary: (VIN) appaccuddhāraṇaṃ nāma tassa vā adinnaṃ, tassa vā avissasanto paribhuñjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā sikkhamānāya vā sāmaṇerassa vā sāmaṇeriyā vā sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ vikappetvā appaccuddhāraṇaṃ paribhuñjeyya, pācittiyan'ti.
appaccuddhāraṇe vematiko paribhuñjati, āpatti pācittiyassa. appaccuddhāraṇe appaccuddhāraṇasaññī paribhuñjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.

6786.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of paccuddhāraṇa, neg
6786.construction:
na > a + pati > paty > pacc + ud + √dhar > dhār + *aṇa + aṃ
appaccuddhāraṇa + aṃ
6786.commentary: (VIN 2.5.6.9) appaccuddhāraṇaṃ nāma tassa vā adinnaṃ, tassa vā avissasanto paribhuñjati, āpatti pācittiyassa

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā sikkhamānāya vā sāmaṇerassa vā sāmaṇeriyā vā sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ vikappetvā appaccuddhāraṇaṃ paribhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

6787.meaning1: not discerning the characteristics; not differentiating the character
6787.construction: na > a + pati > paty > pacc + upa + √lakkh + aṇa

examples.text: rūpe kho, vaccha, appaccupalakkhaṇā … viññāṇe kho, vaccha, appaccupalakkhaṇā ….

6788.meaning1: not thinking about; not reviewing; not re-considering
6788.construction: na > a + pati > paty > pacc + upa + √ikkh + aṇa

examples.text: rūpe kho, vaccha, appaccupekkhaṇā … viññāṇe kho, vaccha, appaccupekkhaṇā ….

6789.meaning1: not giving up; not abandoning; not letting go
6789.construction:
na > a + pa + jaha + ana + ka
appajahana + ka

6790.grammar: prp of na pajahati, neg, trans (+acc)
6790.meaning1: not giving up; not abandoning; not letting go (of)
6790.commentary: (SNa) anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahan'ti anabhijānanto aparijānanto avirājento appajahanto.

examples.text: rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya

6791.grammar: prp of na pajānāti, neg, trans (+acc)
6791.meaning1: not knowing; not clearly understanding; not distinguishing

examples.text: ye ca rūp'ūpagā sattā, ye ca arūpaṭṭhāyino, nirodhaṃ appajānantā, āgantāro punabbhavaṃ.
so manasikaraṇīye dhamme appajānanto amanasikaraṇīye dhamme appajānanto, ye dhammā na manasikaraṇīyā, te dhamme manasi karoti, ye dhammā manasikaraṇīyā te dhamme na manasi karoti

6792.grammar: pp of na paññāpeti, neg, caus
6792.meaning1: (of a rule) not formulated; not prescribed; not decreed; not declared

6793.grammar: pp of na paññāpeti, neg, caus
6793.meaning1: not prepared; not readied; not arranged; not laid out

6794.commentary: (MNa) apaññātā'ti dvinnaṃ janānaṃ ṭhitaṭṭhāne na paññāyanti, ghāsacchādanamattam'pi na labhanti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso ñāto hoti yasassī. so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi ñāto yasassī, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū appaññātā app'esakkhā'ti. so tena ñattena attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.
aham'asmi lābhasakkārasilokavā, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū appaññātā app'esakkhā'ti. so tena lābhasakkārasilokena majjati pamajjati pamādaṃ āpajjati, pamatto samāno dukkhaṃ viharati.

6795.meaning2: lack of fame, lack of reputation

6796.meaning1: short indeed; small indeed; truly insignificant

examples.text: tasmā hi sikkhetha idh'eva jantu, yaṃ kiñci jaññā visaman'ti loke, na tassa hetū visamaṃ careyya, appañ'h'idaṃ jīvitam'āhu dhīrā.
appañ'hi etaṃ na alaṃ samāya, duve vivādassa phalāni brūmi, etam'pi disvā na vivādayetha, khem'ābhipassaṃ avivādabhūmiṃ.

6797.meaning1: not making amends; not redressing; not fixing; not repairing

6798.meaning1: (of an offence) not amendable; irreparable; unrehabilitatable
6798.commentary: (VINa) cha sappaṭikammā'ti pārājikaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā. ek'ettha appaṭikammā'ti ekā pārājik'āpatti. (ANa) sappaṭikamm'āpatti nāma sāvases'āpatti'y'eva, appaṭikamm'āpatti nāma anavases'āpatti'y'eva.

examples.text: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū lahukaṃ āpattiṃ garukā āpattī'ti dīpenti … sappaṭikammaṃ āpattiṃ appaṭikammā āpattī'ti dīpenti … appaṭikammaṃ āpattiṃ sappaṭikammā āpattī'ti dīpenti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujana-ahitāya paṭipannā bahujana-asukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
